REFACTOR-02 is accepted through PR18 (merge `58eda69fd86f6784aa5fbdcfbec4a526b212b0f4`, independent review5661046362, implementation CI8/8). This separate PR records that acceptance:02done,03ready, canonical date2026-10-27, preserved card/history and updated Wiki. REFACTOR-03 has not started.

The mandatory P2 in the first accounting head is fixed. An inherited Git worktree/index/config could make the scope reader inspect a clean neighbor and falsely accept a forbidden tools edit. Every Git read now uses the accepted `tools.common.git.git_environment()`; the root is anchored to the reader source through common `project_root`. The allowlist, byte/SHA guards, budgets and inspection algorithms are unchanged. Metadata is strictly checked against version0.0.356.

Current head: `6dd6c3bb4d77bb7d2eddcb23199aff2f698221aa`.
Base: `58eda69fd86f6784aa5fbdcfbec4a526b212b0f4`.
P2 thread: https://github.com/sergey-leonidovich-shevchenko/babushkina-ferma/pull/19#discussion_r4384617589

Validation on0.0.356:
- 12 real regression cases on both Python3.11 and3.9,13 reader subprocesses per run, including actual clone/linked worktree with spaces and tracked/staged/untracked/new-staged corruption. The identical red corpus exposed four false PASS before the fix. Source/foreign index/config, files and parent environment stayed unchanged; disposable fixtures were removed.
- The reviewer's exact reproduction now rejects both ordinary and inherited-Git corruption (exit1/1 versus1/0). Source-root and unrelated cwd controls pass.
- Fresh complete `tools/check_architecture.sh`:83 suites/1148 cases; `./run_tests.sh`:53502/0 and actual-main headless normal/F10:90/0 each; `pnpm --dir wiki check`: export/TypeScript/build/145 tests passed.
- Byte preservation:585 accepted reports,798UID,13 plans/archives. Of66 files in rejected d714 packet,65 are unchanged; the corrected reader's original bytes are archived exactly. Old raw/checks and failed attempts are retained.
- Wiki browser: desktop1280 and390CSSpx, history83/unknown20, accepted date27 and equal-date source order,02done/03ready, pilot52/52, manual refresh, actual P2 JSON and matching source/public/dist. Own read-only server/tab closed, viewport reset.
- Final scope, preservation, documentation, version, backlog and staged whitespace checks passed.70 new evidence files sealed by SHA in `review-1/checks.json`.

Evidence: `docs/reports/refactor-02/closeout/review-1/README.md`, `checks.json`, real red/green/reviewer reproduction, final gate logs and browser JSON/PNG. Reader SHA256 `37671ee4fa62ea6939c1a224349e41d96cea789db0e9e798d82644aef21bc113`; same regression corpus `a76defa579172eba4f92933fb89a43fa29db514ed12bb81d1289f35bd16060e1`.

Exactly one existing `Task-Complete: REFACTOR-02` is retained; the P2 commit adds none. Runtime/tools/tests/assets/scenes/planning state and sources are unchanged. Root544 / future forecast10 / limit30 remain separate; no FPS/VMAP acceptance. Full mandatory gates were completed before commit; `--no-verify` avoided only their redundant long hook rerun, and the ordinary post-commit hook ran.

Rejected d714 had7/8 CI: macOS failed during Git checkout (curl56/earlyEOF), before tests; its log is retained separately. Neither those checks nor accepted implementation CI approve this new head. This draft requires its own exact-head CI, independent Tech Lead re-review and Team Lead decision before merge or03.

comments.body: [P2] Изолируйте Git-контекст scope-проверки. `cwd=root` не отменяет унаследованные `GIT_DIR`, `GIT_WORK_TREE` и `GIT_INDEX_FILE`: byte-level часть читает `root`, а `git diff`/`ls-files` ниже могут читать другой worktree. В disposable clone текущего head комментарий в tools/common/git.py правильно даёт exit1; с Git-контекстом чистого соседнего checkout тот же helper даёт exit0 и `runtime_tools_tests_planning_unchanged=true`. В среде нескольких worktree это маскирует запрещённое изменение tools. Передавайте очищенное окружение через уже принятую общую `git_environment()` и добавьте отрицательный контроль: tracked/untracked изменение текущего checkout должно отклоняться и при наследуемых worktree/index/config overrides. Старые raw оставьте историческими, новые red/green доказательства приложите отдельно.

В моей отдельной копии 12cases/13actualreader subprocesses успешно выполнены на Python3.11 и3.9: tracked/staged/untracked/new-staged, worktree/index/config-only/bare, clean/othercwd и порча прежнегоraw. Source/foreign index/config/files и parent env прежние, оба temporaryfixture удалены. Новые70SHA/прежний66packet/1396baseline проверены; старыйreader точно архивирован. P2 закрываю.
